Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Tamim Iqbal and Najmul Hossain Shanto will open the batting for Bangladesh. Alzarri Joseph will begin the proceedings with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

For West Indies, it was only Nicholas Pooran! Had it not been for him, West Indies would have been dismissed for around 100 runs. After being put in to bat first, West Indies lost their top 3 batters within a blink of an eye. Post that, Keacy Carty and Nicholas Pooran put together over 50 runs and got things under control. However, Keacy Carty perished soon after a fine knock of 33 and since then West Indies were unable to build another stand. Romario Shepherd's cameo, in the end, helped West Indies get close to that 180 mark and has given his bowlers something to bowl at. But overall, it's been another disappointing effort with the blade. West Indies do face a tough task ahead. They will need something special to save this game and avoid a whitewash. Can they do so? We will find out. Stay tuned for the second essay.

Tamim Iqbal will be one happy man! His bowlers have once again justified his decision to bowl first. Also, bringing in Taijul Islam for the final ODI has done wonders for Bangladesh! He was certainly their trump card in this innings. The visitors started the innings on the right foot. They grabbed three early wickets and put West Indies under the pump instantly. However, post that they did let the hosts get away with a partnership. Although they made sure to keep a lid on the run-flow. Once they broke the stand between Nicholas Pooran and Keacy Carty, they kept picking wickets at regular intervals. Eventually, they bundled out West Indies for 178! Taijul Islam was certainly the leader of the pack. He ended with 5 wickets by his name, while Nasum Ahmed and Mustafizur Rahman grabbed two wickets each.

Another day, another match, and another stupendous bowling display from Bangladesh! Nothing has changed so far in this ODI series. The story remains the same! Bangladesh winning the toss, electing to bowl first, and dismissing West Indies for a below-par score! They have once again used the conditions perfectly and demolished the batting lineup of the hosts. They do have an opportunity to whitewash West Indies in the 50-over format!

OUT! CLEANED UP! Nasum Ahmed comes back strongly and grabs the final wicket. It is floated and full, around off. Romario Shepherd gets low and tries to heave across the line but misses. The ball goes through to shatter the stumps. West Indies get bowled yet again in this series. This time on 178.
SIX! He gets a hold of this one. Tossed up, full and on off. Romario Shepherd frees his arms and smokes it over the long on fence for a maximum.
This one comes in with the arm, on leg. Romario Shepherd fails to pick it up.
Full and on off. Alzarri Joseph clips it through mid-wicket for one.
An appeal for lbw but turned down. It is slower yet again, touch fuller, on middle and leg. Romario Shepherd fails to flick it away. The impact seems to be outside the line.
Full length, wide outside off. Romario Shepherd tries to tonk it down the ground but fails to connect.
Slower one, moving away from outside off. Romario Shepherd leaves it alone.

WIDE! It is full, down the leg side. Romario Shepherd tries to flick it away. The keeper dives to his left, gathers the ball and appeals for a caught behind. The umpire gives it a thought and signals a wide. Tamim Iqbal wastes no time in taking the review. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. Romario Shepherd survives.
Good length, on off, a slower one. Romario Shepherd defends it to point. He ventures out looking for a single but is sent back.
Change of bats for Romario Shepherd!
Length ball, on off. Alzarri Joseph punches it through covers for a single.

DROPPED! Tamim Iqbal makes a meal of this one. It is short and on off. Romario Shepherd heaves across the line. It flies off the outside edge towards mid off. Tamim Iqbal settles under it but does not catch it cleanly. They take one.
Full and outside off. Romario Shepherd pushes it through covers for a single.
Tossed up, on off. Romario Shepherd hits it over the bowler's head. They take a couple.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Alzarri Joseph flicks it to square leg for one.
Another single as this is pushed to cover yet again.
Tossed up, on off, Joseph punches it to cover for a single.
Darted on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
Good length, on off. Alzarri Joseph punches it to point for another single.
Length ball, on the pads, Romario Shepherd flicks it to the leg side for one.
This one stays low, also it is a slower delivery, just outside off. Romario Shepherd throws his blade at it but is unable to connect.
Length ball, on off, pushed to covers.
Length ball, on off. Alzarri Joseph guides it to backward point for one.
Full length, outside off, shaping away. Alzarri Joseph swings hard but misses. Wided.
This one is on the pads, Alzarri Joseph flicks it to square leg and crosses. 6 runs off the over. The final pair is managing to keep the runs ticking.
A single as this is worked towards mid-wicket.
Looped up, on off, defended out solidly.
Flatter one, outside off. Romario Shepherd tries to cut it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! Incredible shot. It is short and on off. Romario Shepherd is quick to pick up the length. He pulls it to deep mid-wicket and finds the gap for a boundary.
Full and angled into the pads. Romario Shepherd tries to push it away but gets hit on the pads.
Full length, outside off, angled across the right-hander. Alzarri Joseph moves across and defends it towards covers.
Alzarri Joseph is the last man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Another bites the dust! It's Mustafizur Rahman who grabs his second wicket and sends Gudakesh Motie back to the hut! A soft dismissal! A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Gudakesh Motie rocks back and tries to slash this away but the ball goes off his inside edge and back onto the stumps. West Indies lose their 9th wicket!
Another slower ball, outside off, a length ball. Gudakesh Motie stays in his crease and tries to cut this away but he gets a slight under-edge back onto the deck.
A length ball, slower in pace, around middle and off, this one stays low as well. Gudakesh Motie keeps it out.
On a length, outside off again. Romario Shepherd pushes it towards cover and rotates the strike!
Fuller ball, outside off, angling away. Romario Shepherd leans to drive but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full and on middle. Gudakesh Motie blocks it out. End of a terrific spell from Taijul Islam! He ends with figures of 10-2-28-5!
Outside off, shorter one. Gudakesh Motie cuts it towards point and takes a couple of runs.
Fuller, loopy one, around middle. Gudakesh Motie pushes it back to the bowler.
Gudakesh Motie is the new batter in.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! A five-wicket haul for Taijul Islam! His first in ODIs! What a game he is having. He gets rid of the West Indies skipper now. A fuller ball, spinning in, around middle. Nicholas Pooran shimmies down the track and looks to heave this again, but he misses this time. The ball goes onto shatter the stumps. A fine knock from Nicholas Pooran comes to an end!
Loopy ball, around middle and leg, fuller one. Nicholas Pooran advances the pitch and miscues his heave towards deep square leg for a brace.
Loopy ball, and outside off. Nicholas Pooran steps down the pitch and yorks himself but he does well to dig this one out.
Drifting in, around middle and leg, short again. Nicholas Pooran flicks it off the back foot through mid-wicket for a single. He retains the strike!
Short again, outside off. Nicholas Pooran knocks it out towards cover.
Back of a length, around middle. Romario Shepherd pushes it off the back foot towards long on a single.
Romario Shepherd is the new man in.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Spin strikes once again for Bangladesh! It's Mosaddek Hossain this time! A classical off-spinners dismissal. Tad shorter, it lands around middle and spins away. Akeal Hosein stays in his crease and tries to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge. The ball goes onto to knock the off pole. West Indies are 7 down!
Loopy ball, full again, around off. Nicholas Pooran once again, steps down the pitch and knocks it towards long off for a single.
Fuller ball, tosses it up, around middle. Nicholas Pooran dances down the pitch and drills it straight down the pitch, the fielder from long off cuts it out. Two taken!
Shorter ball, outside off, at 129 clicks. Akeal Hosein sways away from it and lets that go through to the keeper.
Back of a length, outside off. Nicholas Pooran miscues his pull shot towards long on for a single.
Pulls his length back a tad now, on middle. Nicholas Pooran swivels and looks to pulls this but he misses and gets hit near his groin area.
Good running! A length ball, around off. Akeal Hosein taps it onto the deck, towards the off side and scampers across to the other end.
Fuller one, at around 129 clicks, around middle. Akeal Hosein blocks it watchfully.
Beaten! On a length, shaping away a tad, outside off. Akeal Hosein tries to drive this one but he misses.
Time for Powerplay 3! Bangladesh are now allowed to keep 5 fielders outside the inner circle.
FOUR! Swept away nicely. It is tossed up, full and on off. Pooran gets down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for four. Pooran playing a captain's knock here.
Around off, Pooran defends it solidly on the front foot.
Flatter, outside off. Pooran blocks it to point.
Loopy ball, on off, defended out.
SIX! Back-to-back maximums. Full again, on off. Pooran dances down the track and smokes it over the long on fence for a maximum.
SIX! BANG! It is tossed up, full and on off. Pooran dances down the track and smokes it over the long on fence for a maximum.
A wicket-taking over comes to an end. It is full and on off, defended out.
Full, on the pads, Hosein tucks it to the leg side.
Full, on middle and leg, defended out.
Akeal Hosein is the new batter in.

OUT! STUMPED! Nurul Hasan at his best behind the sticks. Taijul Islam records his four-fer. He has the last laugh here. It is tossed up, around off, spinning away off the deck. Paul gets on his front foot a little too much. He tries to defends but gets beaten on the outside edge. Hasan collects the ball and whips the bails in a flash. The umpire takes it upstairs. The replays confirm that Paul has no part of his back leg behind the crease.
Commentary.Howout: st Nurul Hasan b Taijul Islam

Commentary.Commentary: A stumping chance! Keemo Paul is walking back but the umpires are checking this one. No bat involved confirms, UltraEdge. The replay shows at Keemo Paul's back leg is out of the crease. He has to depart!
On off, blocked out.
FOUR! Nicely played. It is full and on off. Paul gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full and touch outside off. Pooran blocks it out to point.
LEG BYE! On middle and leg. Paul misses to tuck it away. It rolls off his pads and they collect a leg bye.
On off, defended out.
Slight halt! Keemo Paul seems to have pulled his hamstring while completing the single. The physio is out there in the middle.

FIFTY FOR POORAN! This is his first as an ODI skipper, also his first against Bangladesh. It is full, outside off. Pooran pushes it to cover and scampers across for a quick single. It looks like Keemo Paul has hurt himself in the process.
Outside off. Pooran dabs it to backward point.
A dot to start with! Full and on off. Pooran drives it to covers.
Quicker and full, on off. Paul lunges and tries to defend it out. It goes past the short third man off the outer half. They collect a brace.
Paul gets on his front foot to defend this full delivery.
Full and on off. Paul punches it to cover.
Tossed up, full and on off. Paul blocks it solidly.
Full and on off. Paul eases it back to the bowler.

DRINKS! Bangladesh have broken two important partnerships and have taken things under control once again. West Indies are taking things slowly for now. They have lost half their side now, but they still do have their skipper Nicholas Pooran at the crease. If he will be hoping to guide his side to a total close to 200 in the remaining overs. Also, Keemo Paul joins him in the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! Oh dear, did I jinx it? Taijul Islam proves me wrong and breaks this crucial stand. It is tossed up, on middle. Powell makes room for himself but fails to cover his line. He ends up playing all around it. The ball sneaks through and shatters the stumps. West Indies are five wickets down now. Can Bangladesh end things early on?
A single as this is worked down to long on. This stand is growing really well.
On middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
Floated and full, on off. Powell defends it on his front foot.
Around the pads, Powell flicks it to mid-wicket but not in the gap.
On the pads, Powell tucks it through square leg for a brace.
SIX! BANG! Rovman Powell unleashes his raw power this time. It is full and outside off. Powell uses his feet and smokes it over the long off fence.
Change. Mehidy Hasan (5-0-35-0) is back into the attack.
Shorter one, spinning in, around the pads. Nicholas Pooran hangs back and tucks it towards square leg.
FOUR! Sweetly done! Loopy ball, slower through the air, alow full toss. Nicholas Pooran dances down the wicket and drives it wide of mid off for a boundary. Much-needed boundary for West Indies!
Outside off, fuller in length. Rovman Powell strokes it down to long off and takes another single.
Back to over the wicket for the left-hander. A shorter one, quicker as well, around off. Nicholas Pooran stays in his crease and dabs it towards short third man for a single.
Goes 'round the wicket now, serves a fuller one, down the leg side. Rovman Powell sweeps it towards short fine leg for a single.
Loopy ball, very full, outside off. Nicholas Pooran knocks it down to long off and takes a single.
Slower one, on a length, darting it on the thigh pads. Rovman Powell flicks it towards square leg for a brace. 100 up for West Indies!
Oh, well bowled! On a length, outside off, shaping away just a tad. Rovman Powell advances down the pitch and tries to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Width on offer now, shorter ball. Nicholas Pooran cuts it away towards point for a single.
Tight single! Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Rovman Powell pushes it toward mid on and scampers across for a quick single.
Change of pace now! He serves a slower one, at 111 clicks, full again, around middle and leg. Nicholas Pooran knocks it down to long on and rotates the strike!
Swing and a miss! Mustafizur Rahman begins his second spell with a fuller ball, outside off, at 131 clicks. Nicholas Pooran leans to drive this but he misses.
Change. Mustafizur Rahman (4-0-10-1) is back into the attack now.
On middle, fuller ball. Rovman Powell shows the full face of the bat and defends it out. Just 1 run off the over!
Another loopy ball, around off. Rovman Powell lunges forward and pushes it towards point. No run taken there!
A ripper! Loopy ball, it lands around off and spins away. Rovman Powell leans to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Goes 'round the wicket now, serves a fuller ball, outside off. Rovman Powell presses forward and blocks it out towards point.
On middle, pitches it up. Nicholas Pooran dances down the pitch and works it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, tad quicker at 88 clicks, full in length. Nicholas Pooran strides forward and dabs it towards point. No run taken!
Dot to end the over! Full and around off. Rovman Powell drives it to the fielder at cover.
Back of a length, around off. Nicholas Pooran uses the depth of his crease and pulls it towards long on for a single.

Mix-up...but no harm done! A fuller ball, around off. Nicholas Pooran strides forward and taps it towards cover. He leaves his crease to sneak in a run but he is sent back in time. He dives in to makes his ground.
Outside off, fullish ball. Nicholas Pooran dabs it towards short third man.
Full again, around middle and leg. Nicholas Pooran steps down and flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller ball, spinning away a tad, around off. Nicholas Pooran presses forward and taps it towards cover-point. He wanted a single there but Rovman Powell denies the run!
Shorter one, around middle. Nicholas Pooran pulls it with the spin towards deep square leg for a single. He retains the strike!
Tad quicker, spinning in, around the leg pole. Nicholas Pooran hangs back and blocks it towards leg side.
Around middle, fuller ball. Nicholas Pooran sweeps and finds the fielder at square leg.
Floats it up, serves it full and around middle and leg. Rovman Powell knocks it down to long off for a single.
Another loopy one, outside off, full again. Rovman Powell defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up, full and on middle, at 86 clicks. Rovman Powell leans and blocks it out.
Full and on off, Pooran defends it out.
On off, blocked out watchfully.
Tossed up, outside off. Pooran looks to push it away but misses.
This one spins a lot. Lands on off and spins away. Pooran chases but misses.
On off, pushed to covers. Two dots in a row now. Bangladesh spinners have done well to maintain the pressure.
Full, on middle and leg. Pooran clears his front leg and smothers it out.
On off, defended out solidly. Just 2 runs off the over then.
Short ball, difting down leg. Pooran pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Floated and full, around off. Pooran eases it back to the bowler.
Flatter, on the stumps. Pooran defends it into the deck.
Full and on off. Powell eases it to long off for a single.
Quicker and on the stumps. Powell blocks it out.
Tossed up, on off. Pooran pushes it to mid on for a couple of runs.
Looped up, on off. Powell tucks it to the leg side and crosses for one.
On leg, Powell tucks it to the leg side.
Tossed up, on off. Powell defends it to cover.
This one comes in with the arm. Powell tries to flick it away but it rolls out of his pads.
On off, blocked out watchfully.
A single now as this is pushed out to cover. Powell is off the mark instantly.
Rovman Powell comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Nasum Ahmed finally finds the breakthrough. Keacy Carty has to walk back but he has done enough to build a solid platform for the rest of the pack. It is touch short, on off. Carty stays on the back foot and heaves across the line. The ball flies towards mid on off the outer half. Tamim Iqbal settles under it and takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Tamim Iqbal b Nasum Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Brilliant delivery! It is looped up, outside off, turns away off the deck. Keacy Carty tries to play it late but gets beaten by the turn.
Full and on leg. Pooran sweeps it to square leg for a single.
Around off, blocked out.
Tossed up, on off. Pooran defends it late to the left of the keeper. The keeper gathers it quickly.
Nasum Ahmed (4-1-14-0) comes back to bowl!
Tossed up, full and on off. Pooran clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, Carty clips it to the leg side for a single.
This one keeps low, around off. Carty flicks it to mid-wicket.
Around off, Pooran punches it to cover for a single.
On off, blocked out.
Floated and full, outside off. Pooran drives it to covers.
FOUR! Oh, good shot! Fuller one, around off. Keacy Carty stays in his crease, opens the face of his bat and guides it towards third man. It races away towards the fence for a boundary.
Back of a length, spinning in, around middle. Keacy Carty tries to flick this one but he misses and gets hit high on his pads.
Back of a length, outside off. Nicholas Pooran dabs it towards point and takes a quick single.
Nice stop! Another short one, it stays low once again, outside off. Nicholas Pooran cuts it onto the deck and towards the first slip fielder, who dive to his left and makes a good stop.
Short ball, outside off, it stays very low this time. Nicholas Pooran stays in his crease and tries to cut this away but he misses.
Tunring away, shortish ball, around middle and off. Keacy Carty flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker, at around 89 clicks, outside off. Nicholas Pooran cuts it towards backward point.
Quick single! Full, outside off, loopy one. Keacy Carty drives it towards mid off and takes a run.
On middle, pitched up ball. Keacy Carty defends it back to the bowler.
Another fuller one, around off. Nicholas Pooran strokes it down to long off for a single.
Full again, around off, slower through the air. Nicholas Pooran steps down once again and drives it to the fielder at cover.
Loopy one, outside off, around off. Nicholas Pooran advances down the pitch and pushes it towards cover.
Tosses it up, pitches it up, around middle. Nicholas Pooran knocks it down to long on for a single.
Fuller, loopy ball, around off. Nicholas Pooran drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Another one, outside off, short again. Nicholas Pooran cuts it towards short third man.
Spinning away, back of a length, outside off. Nicholas Pooran pushes it towards the bowler.
Quicker, outside off, shortish ball. Keacy Carty cuts it towards point and takes a single.

SIX! Bang! A confident strike from Keacy Carty! A fuller one, around middle, slower as well. Keacy Carty advances down the pitch and tonks it down the ground for a biggie. That brings up the 50-run stand between these two!
Touch short again, outside off. Nicholas Pooran dabs it towards cover.
Shorter one, spinning away, outside off. Nicholas Pooran pushes it off the back foot towards point.
FOUR! Deft touch! Nicely done! Fuller, outside off, tad slower. Nicholas Pooran stays in his crease, crouches down, opens the face of his bat and guides it towards third man for a boundary.
Fuller one, quicker, around middle. Nicholas Pooran steps down the pitch and pushes it towards cover.
Beaten! Lovely delivery! Turn and bounce! Shorter one, outside off, turning away. Nicholas Pooran hangs back and lets that go through to the keeper.
Back of a length, outside off. Nicholas Pooran dabs it towards short third man.
Fuller one now, around middle. Keacy Carty sweeps but the finds the fielder at square leg. A maiden over from Afif Hossain!
Drifting in, around middle, shorter one. Keacy Carty flicks it toward mid-wicket.
Back of a length, around middle and leg. Keacy Carty blocks it out towards the leg side.
Shorter one, outside off, this one stays low. Keacy Carty stays in his crease and pushes it towards point.
Around off, fuller one. Keacy Carty blocks it out off the front foot.
Swing and a miss! A fuller ball, outside off. Keacy Carty looks to drive this but he misses.
Full, on middle and leg, Pooran blocks it out with full face.
Five dots on the trot. It is full, on off. Pooran uses his feet to block it back to the bowler.
On off, blocked back to the bowler.
Full and outside off. Pooran defends it to cover on the front foot.
Full again, on the stumps. Pooran stays back and blocks it to the off side.
Full, on off. Pooran defends it back to the bowler.
WIDE! Fuller, angled down leg, Pooran misses his flick. Wided.
It is a short ball, outside off. Pooran cuts it to point. The ball lands short of the fielder. There is a misfield which allows the batters to collect a single.
A single as this is worked down to mid on.
On off, played back to the bowler on a bounce.
It is tossed up, around leg. Carty goes for the sweep but misses. He gets hit on the pads. Hossain appeals but the umpire disagrees.
On the pads, tucked to mid-wicket.
Full and on off. Carty plays it back to the bowler.

DRINKS! After losing three wickets in quick succession, Nicholas Pooran and Keacy Carty are doing some kind of repair work. The duo have put together 40 runs so far and are taking no risk at the moment. They will want to keep going the same way for now and ensure West Indies do not fall into trouble once again. Also, Afif Hossain comes into the attack.
Tossed up, outside off. Pooran cuts it to point but not able to find the gap.
On off, Pooran defends it out solidly.
Full and on off. Pooran plays it late and dabs it to backward point.
Loopy ball, on off. Pooran comes down the track and defends it into the deck.
On the stumps. Pooran fends it out to backward point on the back foot.
Tossed up, on off. Carty comes down the track and pushes it to cover for a quick single. These two are batting sensibly out here.
Tossed up, around off. Carty drives it towards mid off for another single. A tidy over by Islam comes to an end.
Loopy ball, wide of off. Pooran eases it to cover for another single.
Around off, punched through cover for one.
This one is a touch quicker, on the stumps. Carty defends it to cover on the back foot.
Full and outside off. Pooran comes down the track and flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Looped up, wide of off. Pooran looks to chase it but misses.
Not an official Drinks break, but the players have a quick sip! Also, Taijul Islam (4-2-5-2) comes back into the attack.
Short and wide outside off. Pooran slaps it to sweeper cover for a single. 9 runs off it. A good one for the hosts.
Tossed up, on off. Pooran works it through backward point for a couple.
A dot now! Floated and full, on off. Pooran pushes it to cover.
Around off, turning in. Carty dabs it down to mid off for a single.
This is full and on off. Pooran comes down the track and eases it down the track to long off for one.
FOUR! Nicely played! It is flatter and short, outside off. Nicholas Pooran cuts it through point on the back foot for a boundary.
Swing and a miss! Slower through the air, full and spinning away outside off. Keacy Carty gets down on his knee and tries to sweep this one but he misses.
Slower, fuller, around middle and leg. Keacy Carty flicks this and finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Quicker this time, outside off, shortish ball. Keacy Carty slashes it through backward point for a brace.
Tosses this one up, full and on middle and leg. Nicholas Pooran works it towards mid-wicket and takes a run.
Shorter one from 'round the wicket now, spinning away, outside off, it stays low as well. Keacy Carty knocks it off the back foot towards long off for a single.
Nasum Ahmed goes 'over the wicket, serves a fuller ball and on the pads. Nicholas Pooran tucks it towards fine leg and takes a single.
Pulls his length back this time, outside off. Keacy Carty pushes it towards sweeper cover for a brace.
Loopy ball, outside off, fuller again. Nicholas Pooran drives it through cover for a run.

Tight single! Outside off, loopy ball, full in length. Keacy Carty presses forward and pushes it towards mid off. He scampers across to the other end. The throw at the non-strikers is wide of the stumps.
Fuller one, around middle. Keacy Carty drives but the ball goes off his inner half towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Easy picking! This spins down the leg side, fullish ball. Keacy Carty tucks it fine and towards fine leg for a boundary.
Fuller one, darting it on the pads. Nicholas Pooran flicks it towards mid on and takes a quick single.

Three runs! Outside off, fullish ball. Nicholas Pooran hangs back, opens the face of his bat and guides it towards third man. The fielder there runs across and stops the ball with his foot. Saved a single there!
On the pads, loopy ball, and full in length. Keacy Carty prods forward and tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Turn and bounce! Back of a length, outside off, spinning away. Keacy Carty stays in his crease and leaves it alone.
Shorter one, outside off. Keacy Carty pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Back of a length, spinning away, outside off. Keacy Carty rocks back and tries to cut this away but the ball goes off his bottom edge back to the bowler.
Pitches it up, around middle and leg. Nicholas Pooran knocks it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Quicker, outside off, straighter one. Keacy Carty prods forward to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Shorter one now, around middle and leg. Keacy Carty stays in his crease and flicks it towards square leg. Another dot ball!
On middle, pitched up. Blocked out off the front foot.
Tosses it up, full, around off. Keacy Carty steps down the pitch and misses his flick. He gets hit on his thigh pads.
Fuller one from 'over the wicket, around middle and off. Keacy Carty blocks it out.

Mehidy Hasan begins with a shorter ball, spins away from the left-hander, outside off. Nicholas Pooran pushes it off the back foot through cover-point. The fielder chases the ball and does well to keep the ball away from the ropes. Three taken!
Change. Mehidy Hasan comes into the attack now.
Tad fuller, angling in, around middle. Keacy Carty defends it out. A maiden over!
Fuller one, around middle and leg. Keacy Carty clips it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter one, much straighter, around middle. Keacy Carty defends it out off the back foot.
Beaten now! Tosses it up, full and spinning away, outside off. Keacy Carty leans forward and tries to block this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Fuller one, loopy ball, around middle and off. Keacy Carty blocks it out solidly.
Lovely ball! Fuller ball, this is pitching outside leg, it turns sharply towards middle. Keacy Carty stays in his crease and blocks it out.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle till the 40th over!
Three dots in a row to end the over. It is full and on off. Pooran blocks it on the front foot.
Swing and a miss! Loopy ball, wide outside off. Pooran slashes hard but misses.
Third dot in the over. Floated and full, just outside off. Pooran drives it to cover on the front foot.
A single now as this is worked down to mid on.
Looped up, on off, defended out.
A dot to start with! It is tossed up, on the pads. Carty clips it to mid-wicket. No run taken.
Mosaddek Hossain comes into the attack. He replaces Mustafizur Rahman.
On off, defended out solidly. Just a single off the over.
This full delivery is worked to the leg side.
Around off, defended out.
Floated and full, on off. Pooran taps it to point off the back foot.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Pooran flicks it to square leg.
A single now as this is worked to the leg side.

Direct throw and Nicholas Pooran could've been on his way back. It is a length ball, on middle and leg. Keacy Carty tucks it to mid-wicket and scampers across. Mehidy Hasan gathers the ball but misses his attempt at the striker's end. They take one.
Swing and a miss! The dot balls continue to creep up. Full length, wide outside off. Keacy Carty tries to drive it square on the off side but is late into his shot.
Touch fuller, on off. Carty is forced to play at it. He blocks it back to the bowler with soft hands.
This one is angled away from the right-hander yet again. Keacy Carty shoulders his arms at it.
Good length, this one lands around off and leaves the batsman with a sharp movement. Keacy Carty has no shot to offer.
Full length, angled into the pads. Pooran stays back and flicks it to mid-wicket for one. He gets off the mark.
Tossed up, on off. Carty defends it out solidly. A maiden for Taijul Islam. Bangladesh continue to start brightly with the ball in this series.
Length and on off. Carty punches it to mid off.
Full and outside off. Carty blocks it back to the bowler.
Looped up, on the pads, Carty flicks it to mid-wicket.
Drifts into the pads, Carty flicks it square on the leg side.
Fuller, outside off. Carty pushes it to cover on the front foot.
This one stays very low! Full length, wide of off, Pooran shoulders his arms at it.
Length ball, on off. Pooran blocks it out.
Full length, angling down leg. Pooran stays back and clips it to mid-wicket only to find the fiedler.

OUT! LBW! The umpire raises the finger for lbw, although Shamarh Brooks goes for the review straightaway. Coming to the delivery. It is a length ball, around middle, nips in off the deck. Shamarh Brooks misses to tuck it away and gets rapped on his pads. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows that it is umpire's call on the ball hitting the wickets. The on-field decision is out and Brooks has to walk back to the dugout.
Nicholas Pooran the skipper of West Indies walks out to bat at number 5.
WIDE! This one goes down leg. Brooks leaves it alone. Wided.
Wild swing and a miss! Good length, wide outside off. Brooks slashes hard but misses. The ball zips past the outside edge.
Full length, on off. Brooks defends it out watchfully.
Quicker, at around 93 clicks. around off. Keacy Carty blocks it out. A wicket-maiden from Taijul Islam!
Keacy Carty comes in at number 4.

OUT! STUMPING! Two wickets in two overs for Taijul Islam! West Indies lose another one in quick succession. Another lovely delivery. He tosses it up, full, it lands around off and spins away. Shai Hope strides forward a long way to drive this away, but he gets beaten as the ball turns away from his blade. Nurul Hasan grabs the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. No bat involved there, confirms UltraEdge. The replay also shows that Shai Hope's back foot is not back in time. He has to depart!
Commentary.Howout: st Nurul Hasan b Taijul Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Is that out? The umpire takes it upstairs to check the stumping. The replays show his foot isn't behind the line. The final decision is OUT.
Loopy one, shorter, outside off. Shai Hope pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Shorter one, spinning away, outside off, this one stays low as well. Shai Hope stays in the crease and tries to cut this away but he gets undone by the lack of bounce.
Outside off now, fuller ball. Shai Hope lunges forward and drives it towards cover.
Tad quicker at 89 clicks, drifting in, around middle and leg. Shai Hope uses the depth of his crease and blocks it out.
Quick single! Full again, outside off, at around 131 clicks. Shai Hope leans and pushes it towards mid off. He scampers across to the other end.
Tad fuller, outside off, at 131 clicks. Shai Hope presses forward and then lets that go through to the keeper.
Wide! Down the leg side now, a length ball. Shai Hope tries to flick this one but he misses. Wide called!
Width on offer now, fuller ball. Shai Hope leans forward, and tries to drive this one but the ball goes off his inside edge back onto his pads.
On a length, shaping away, outside off, at 134 clicks. Shai Hope leaves it alone.
Pitches it up again, swinging in, around middle. Shai Hope works it away towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Shai Hope flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Fires this one on the pads, fullish ball. Shamarh Brooks flicks it towards square leg. End of a successful first over from Taijul Islam!
Full and on middle and leg. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out solidly.
This one comes in with the arm, fuller and quicker. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out off the front foot.
FOUR! Shamarh Brooks gets off the mark in style! Loopy ball, full, around off. Shamarh Brooks gets down on his knee and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
Shorter one, around middle. Shamarh Brooks blocks it out off the back foot.
Shamarh Brooks is the new man in.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! A wicket on his very first delivery! This is a perfect start for Taijul Islam and Bangladesh! They have got an early breakthrough yet again. A peach of a delivery! Tosses it up, this one lands around middle and spins away. Brandon King presses forward and tries to block this but he misses due to the vicious spin. The ball goes on to knock the stumps. Brandon King departs!
Change. Taijul Islam comes into the attack now.
Outside off this time, at 130 clicks, maintains the full length. Shai Hope blocks it off the front foot towards cover. 5 runs off the over. Positive start for West Indies!
Angling in, fuller in length, around middle and leg. Brandon King clips it through square leg. Single taken!
Pitches it up, around middle. Brandon King works it towards mid-wicket. No run taken there!
Swinging in again, full, and around middle and leg. Brandon King looks to work it on the leg side, but the ball goes off his inner half towards square leg.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! This one is angling in, pitching it around the leg pole, fuller ball. Brandon King flicks it fine, towards fine leg for a boundary.
Mustafizur Rahman starts off with a fuller ball from over the wicket, wide of off. Brandon King lunges forward, drives, and finds the fielder at mid off.
Mustafizur Rahman to steam in from the other end with the second new ball.
Loopy one, full, and on middle. Shai Hope presses forward and defends it out watchfully. 4 runs off the first over!
Turn and bounce! Shorter one, spinning away, outside off. Shai Hope does well to block it out.
Nasum Ahmed pulls his length back now, outside off. Brandon King pushes it off the back foot through cover. Three taken! Brandon King is off the mark as well!
Some turn this time! Pitches it up, it lands around off and spins away sharply. Brandon King leaves it alone.
Another fuller one, outside off. Brandon King lunges forward and pushes it towards cover.
Nasum Ahmed begins with a fuller ball, tosses it up, around off. Shai Hope knocks it down to long off for a single. Shai Hope and West Indies are underway!
The match is set to begin. Bangladesh players stride out to the middle. Shai Hope and Brandon King come out to open with the blade for West Indies. Nasum Ahmed to start with the new ball.

PITCH REPORT -Stacy-Ann King is pitchside. She says that we are blessed with clear skies and sunshine. Adds that Bangladesh have used the conditions perfectly they have bowled in the right areas and have been rewarded. Informs that the pitch is firm and dry, with very less cracks and no moisture. It's still going to assist the spinners and the batters will find it tough once again.

Nicholas Pooran the captain of West Indies says it is a new day and a new opportunity. Mentions they would've liked to win the toss and would want to bowl first but as a team, they are going to accept this challenge. Mentions that they will try to dig deeper. Ends by saying they also only have a single change, Kyle Mayers misses out and Keacy Carty comes in.

Tamim Iqbal the skipper of Bangladesh says they are going to bowl first again, the reason is simple, batting is a little tough on this wicket. Adds that this wicket is still assisting the spinners and they just have to go with whatever they have on offer. Mentions they have one change to their side. Taijul Islam comes in for Shoriful Islam.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Shai Hope (WK), Brandon King, Shamarh Brooks, Keacy Carty (In for Kyle Mayers), Nicholas Pooran (C), Rovman Powell, Romario Shepherd, Keemo Paul, Akeal Hosein, Gudakesh Motie, Alzarri Joseph.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Litton Das, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Mahmudullah, Afif Hossain, Nurul Hasan (WK), Mehidy Hasan, Mosaddek Hossain, Nasum Ahmed, Taijul Islam (In for Shoriful Islam), Mustafizur Rahman.
TOSS -  Bangladesh have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first!

The hosts on the other hand have struggled to get going in the ODI series. Yes, things have not gone in their favour in terms of toss. But the hosts need their batters to pull their socks up in this final encounter. This is also the final opportunity in this series for West Indies to break their 10-match losing streak against Bangladesh in ODIs. You can hardly call this final game a dead rubber with so much stake. Stay tuned for the toss and team updates.
